heroTitle:
Studio na software
mai mayar da hankali kan kayayyaki
heroSub: FiveStar AI yana gina kayan amfanin iOS da kayan aiki na workflow. Muna samar da abin da mutane ke bukata— cikin sauri da amincewa.
rightSub: Samfurin gwaji → Samfuri → Kula da shi
m2Sub: Sarrafa a cikin na'ura, ƙanƙanin bayanai
m3Sub: An inganta don manyan fayiloli da kafofin watsa labarai
aboutLead: Muna rage sarkakiya kuma muna fitar da muhimman siffofi. Muna magance matsalolin gaske a cikin tsarin takardu, abubuwan da ake wallafawa, da ayyukan samarwa.
missionBody: Tabbatar da wuri. Gina tushe tukunna, sannan ka gyara da ra'ayoyi.
principlesBody: UX mai sauƙin fahimta, gudu mai sauri, ƙananan bayanai.
focusTitle: Kayan aiki da tsarin aikin iOS
focusBody: OCR, sarrafa PDF, kunna bidiyo da sauti, kayan aikin otomatis.
productsLead: Muna ƙirƙirar kayayyakin da ke magance matsalolin gaske.
p1: Tsarin aikin OCR don takardun da aka yi scan: ciro bayanai, bincika, taƙaitawa, TTS—da kiyaye sirri ta hanyar sarrafawa a na’ura.
p2: Mai kunna bidiyo na gida mai sauri da sauƙi. Babu talla. Haɗaka mai zurfi da iOS.
p4: Manhaja wacce ke haɗaka da AI na gida don ba da damar sarrafawa a wurare daban-daban da tattaunawa ta sirri.
p5: Sanya hotunan App Store su zama masu sauƙin fassara da daidaita da harsuna daban-daban don mika su.
p6: Hira ta kusa mai amfani da Bluetooth tare da amincewar mai amfani, tare da zaɓin fassara ta local AI. Babu buƙatar account, kuma babu central chat server.
p7: Manajan pass mai gane wuri. Yana nuna muku coupon ko katin memba da ya dace a lokacin da kuka isa.
p3: Kayan aikin ciki don kayayyakin App Store. An gina su da Swift/SwiftUI.
b2: Local AI da sarrafa aiki ta atomatik
q1: Binciken App Store da sirrin bayanan mai amfani
servicesLead: Bayyana matsala dalla-dalla yana hanzarta isarwa.
s1Body: Yarda a kan manufofi, ma’auna, da iyakoki.
s2Body: Fitarda MVP, sannan a tabbatar da shi ta hanyar amfani na gaske.
contactLead: Kwafi samfurin da ke ƙasa don saurin amsawa.
footerLine1: Studio na software mai mayar da hankali kan samfurori
